title: Growth & Blockers sync - prep
content:
Purpose: quick, focused one-hour 1:1 with Ash to align on my growth plan, unblock the KV-cache perf investigation, and confirm staffing priorities for Q1. Keep it tactical; flag any follow-ups as action items.

Agenda (45-60m total)
- 3m: quick personal check-in (non-work) — energy, PTO, any schedule constraints
- 10m: Career trajectory and next-steps toward Sr. EM candidacy — feedback on scope and signals to demonstrate
- 15m: Current blockers deep-dive (KV cache perf regression, infra quota for dedicated testing) — what I need from Ash / org
- 10m: Priorities + staffing for Q1 roadmap (assigning 0.4 FTE to the latency work, backfill plan)
- 5m: Learning / mentorship plan (courses / stretch projects)
- 5m: Wrap-up + concrete action items and checkpoints

Prep notes / bullets to cover
- Personal check-in: family trip Nov 20-27 (will be offline), prefer async updates week of Nov 22; want to confirm no high-severity on-call ownership those days.

- Career / growth
  - Goal: move from EM->Sr. EM within 9-12 months. Need clarity on gaps: scope of impact, org-level cross-team projects, and hiring/mentorship benchmarks.
  - Ask: Which concrete signals should I drive? (e.g., lead platform-level incident review; own cross-org Dedicated rollout; mentor 2 ICs to next level)
  - Evidence I can present next review: Q1 Dedicated rollout post-mortem, two direct reports with promoted expectations, and latency SLO improvement for core route.

- Blocker 1: KV-cache perf regression (since Oct 12 canary)
  - Symptoms: tail latency p99 up from 120ms->210ms on long-context flows for the ml-routing service. Affects Hosted and Dedicated test clusters.
  - Hypothesis: kernel change in new cudnn / altered compilation path for long sequences; fallback path not engaged correctly.
  - What I have done: bisected commits -> suspicious change in PR #1218 (runtime kernel selection); added extra tracing and disabled continuous batching in canary to narrow repro; opened ENG-4523.
  - What I need from Ash: allocation of a dedicated GPU node for reproducing long-seq perf (estimate 24h of debug time), permission to schedule a short patch rollback in canary if we confirm regression, and help prioritizing ENG-4523 for SRE review.

- Blocker 2: Dedicated infra quota for stress testing
  - We need two g4dn-equivalent nodes in eu-west for a week to validate autoscaler changes and billing sim.
  - Proposed workaround: run scale tests in US with region-tagged traffic, but less ideal for latency/regional differences.
  - Ask: Can we convert a transient trial to a reserved test allocation? If not, who can sign off?

- Q1 priorities alignment
  - My proposed focus: (1) finish KV-cache regression fix + post-mortem, (2) lead rollout of new batching optimizer to 50% traffic on Dedicated, (3) start benchmark harness for quantized models on private clusters.
  - Resource ask: 0.4 FTE for Engin (IC) to lead benchmarking, 0.2 FTE from SRE for test infra. Hiring ask: backfill an IC (ML infra) if Engin is moved.
  - Trade-offs: If Engin not available, move batching optimizer to Q2.

- Mentorship / learning plan
  - Courses: Advanced System Design (O'Reilly) + negotiation coaching for managers. Plan to complete by end of Q1.
  - Mentorship: monthly skip-level syncs with Platform PM (Lina) to get product-level view; request Ash to connect me to a senior EM to shadow for high-level roadmap decisions.

- Data / metrics to show in meeting (bring slides or quick dashboard links)
  - PR review median time last 30d: 28h; aim to reduce to 18h by end of Q1.
  - Incident MTTR last 6m: 3.2h, target keep <4h.
  - KV-cache p99 latency trend (Oct 1-Nov 1): csv attached in Confluence page linked above.
  - Dedicated test utilization: current 62% peak, target >75% for stress windows.

Open questions for Ash to answer in the 1:1
- Does org have budget to provision EU test nodes short-term, or should I plan US-based workarounds?
- Is promoting an EM over 9 months realistic given current promotion cadence? What extra cross-team signals are weighted highest?
- Who do I pull in for the kernel-level perf review? (engineering + applied-ml + release-eng)

Action items I want to leave the meeting with (concrete + owner + timing)
- Ash: confirm EU test node allocation or delegate approver by Nov 6 (owner: Ash, due: 2026-11-06)
- Nadia: finish the canary rollback test and capture perf diff, open follow-up note on Confluence, by Nov 5 (owner: Nadia, due: 2026-11-05)
- Ash/Nadia: schedule 90m cross-team triage with applied-ml and release-eng to look at PR #1218 by Nov 9 (owners: Ash + Nadia, due: 2026-11-09)
- Nadia: draft Sr. EM roadmap snapshot with measurable signals and share with Ash before Nov 16 (owner: Nadia, due: 2026-11-16)

Notes-to-self (scratch)
- Keep the conversation brief and evidence-driven. Don't ask for too many immediate hires in the meeting; focus on one resourcing ask + one growth ask.
- Bring small example of mentorship outcomes (short write-up of Devon promotion plan).
- If Ash pushes back on SR EM timeline, ask for a 6-month review cadence instead.

Follow-ups after meeting (post-1:1 checklist)
- Update Confluence post-mortem draft for ENG-4523 with test logs and perf curves.
- Create a short 2-slide summary of the Sr. EM snapshot for Ash to share with People Ops.
- Tag Engin and SRE in a planning ticket to secure resource time for benchmarking.

Quick links (for the meeting)
- ENG-4523: https://jira.internal/redwood/ENG-4523
- PR #1218: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/1218
- Confluence: serving-runtime/kv-cache-regression-notes

End of prep. Keep this doc as my scratchpad; after the meeting I'll convert the action items into Jira tasks and update the status field here to in_review.
